items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: my daddy was playing violin and he had this fellow Selby Thomas. And Selby Thomas, he was playing bass.

ctx.x: Frank Toast, he played with my daddy. And there was a fellow, they called him Pick, he used to play guitar with my daddy. And Selby Thomas, he was a bass player from the day. See, my daddy, my daddy was playing violin and he had this fellow Selby Thomas. And Selby Thomas, he was playing bass. And, oh, they had another other brother, he used to call him William Alonso. He was a trumpet player. But this little brother, he used to get to high all the time and my daddy, he just got disgusted. And that's when he began…
But he didn't go wrong with Tom Alvitt.
